title: Getting Enough Sleep During Busy Weeks
paragraphs: During a particularly demanding project at work, Wafiq began sacrificing sleep to finish tasks late into the night, telling himself the habit was temporary and would end once the deadline passed.
After three weeks of this pattern, he noticed his concentration during the day had worsened significantly, ironically making tasks take longer than they would have if he had simply rested properly.
A doctor friend explained that sleep deprivation often creates a cycle where tired decisions lead to more mistakes, which then require even more time to fix, undoing any time supposedly saved.

Wafiq adjusted his schedule to prioritize seven hours of sleep, and within a week, he noticed his work quality improving, confirming that rest had not been the obstacle to productivity, but the missing ingredient.
